text:
alice: rolling in v4-int4-candidate (build bld-310) to staging. quick head-up: big latency drop but a hit on token_fidelity and search-MRR. want to agree on a conservative rollout fence.

tom: paste the smoke numbers when you have them.

alice: smoke snapshot (smk-20260324-01):
```
baseline: prod v3.4 (bld-299)
candidate: v4-int4-candidate (bld-310)
samples: N=18k search, 6k longdoc, 12k rerank
metrics:
  token_fidelity: 0.912 -> 0.885 (delta -2.97%, KS p=0.018)
  search_MRR: 0.268 -> 0.260 (delta -2.99%, p=0.044)
  latency_p95: 160ms -> 115ms (win)
```

rachel: KS p=0.018 on token distribution is worrying. that suggests a distributional shift not just variance. automatic rollback rule?

tom: recommend multi-tier guards: immediate rollback if token_fidelity delta <= -3% AND p<=0.05 OR search_MRR delta <= -3% AND p<=0.05. otherwise quiet-burn.

alice: agree. also propose an EWMA-based slow-drift guard on token_fidelity with alpha=0.15, window 60m -> alert if EWMA crosses -1.5% for 20m. catches creeping regressions.

metrics-bot: smk-20260324-01 results: token_fidelity delta -2.97% (KS p=0.018), search_MRR -2.99% (p=0.044). artifact: gs://rwd-smokes/smk-20260324-01.tar.gz

infra-bot: note: v4-int4-candidate reduces cost by ~28% on this build.

rachel: given borderline numbers, my preference: 3-step rollout: 1) 2h AB @2% targeted to search+longdoc; 2) 24h quiet-burn at 0.5% if AB stable; 3) ramp to 10% if quiet-burn clean. immediate rollback if any immediate rule fires.

tom: add route pin for high-sensitivity rerank routes (pin to prod v3.4). example routing snippet I like:
```json
{"pins":[{"route":"search.rerank","pin":"v3.4"}],"quiet_burn_pct":0.5}
```

alice: +1. Also want structured token diffs for top-200 tokens and offline aggregation of user-click concordance for first 20k impressions. rachel can you own that job?

rachel: yes, will run concordance job and produce top-200 token delta list.

ops-bot: ready to schedule. confirm timeline?

alice: schedule AB for 2026-03-25T02:00Z, 2h @2% on search+longdoc. attach rollout guard: immediate rollback on token_fidelity <= -3% & p<=0.05 OR search_MRR <= -3% & p<=0.05; EWMA slow-drip guard as above; route pin for rerank.

ops-bot: scheduled canary smk-20260324-01 at 2026-03-25T02:00Z. guard config saved as rollout-4998887777.json. notifications to #eng-ml and #release-war-room.

metrics-bot: reminder: please attach smoke id in any follow-ups so CI artifacts link correctly.

alice: noted. tagging @tom @rachel for final check before run. thanks.
